name: @testingbot/mcp-server
description: Run and manage browser and mobile tests on TestingBot's cloud of real browsers and devices from Claude.
long_description:
The official TestingBot extension lets Claude work with [TestingBot](https://testingbot.com), a cloud of real desktop browsers, emulators and real mobile devices.

- **Drive a remote browser or device**: open Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge on any OS, or a real iPhone or Android device, then navigate, click, type and take screenshots.
- **Test localhost and private sites** through a TestingBot Tunnel started from Claude.
- **Run test suites**: Maestro, Espresso and XCUITest on real devices; upload apps to TestingBot Storage.
- **Investigate failures**: list tests and builds, read logs, and get an AI analysis of why a test failed.
- **Cross-browser screenshots, live sessions, visual and accessibility checks, team and account management.**

Sign in with your TestingBot API key and secret, or leave them empty and ask Claude to "log me in to TestingBot" (browser sign-in). Sessions and test runs use your TestingBot minutes; a free trial is available.

tools.name: tb_login
tools.description: Authenticate with TestingBot — no API key or secret to copy or paste.

tools.name: getBrowsers
tools.description: List the browsers, versions and platforms (and mobile emulators/simulators, with their browser ID) that TestingBot can run automated tests on.

tools.name: getDevices
tools.description: List TestingBot's physical (real) mobile devices with their ID, name, platform, OS version and whether each is available right now.

tools.name: getTests
tools.description: List the account's most recent tests (newest first) with each test's session ID, name, status, browser, platform, video link and duration.

tools.name: getTestDetails
tools.description: Show everything recorded for one test: name, status and status message, browser, platform and device, duration, build, extra data, and links to the video, screenshots, log files and test page.

tools.name: updateTest
tools.description: Change a test's metadata on TestingBot: its name, pass/fail status, build, or extra data (a JSON string).

tools.name: deleteTest
tools.description: Permanently delete one test and its video, logs and screenshots.

tools.name: stopTest
tools.description: End a test that is still running, immediately, as if the client had quit; the test is kept with its video and logs up to that point.

tools.name: getBuilds
tools.description: List the account's builds (groups of tests that share a build name), newest first, with each build's name, ID, number of tests and creation date.

tools.name: getTestsForBuild
tools.description: List every test in one build, with each test's session ID, status, browser, platform and duration.

tools.name: deleteBuild
tools.description: Permanently delete a build and every test in it, including their videos, logs and screenshots.

tools.name: uploadFile
tools.description: Upload a local app file (.apk, .ipa or .zip) to TestingBot storage and return its `tb://` app URL, to use as `appium:app` in a native-app session (appium_session_management).

tools.name: uploadRemoteFile
tools.description: Have TestingBot download an app file (.apk, .ipa or .zip) from a public http(s) URL into its storage, and return its `tb://` app URL for `appium:app`.

tools.name: getStorageFiles
tools.description: List the app files in the account's TestingBot storage, newest first, with each file's name, `tb://` app URL, type, version and upload time.

tools.name: deleteStorageFile
tools.description: Permanently delete an uploaded app file from TestingBot storage.

tools.name: takeScreenshot
tools.description: Capture screenshots of one URL in several browsers and platforms at once, for a quick visual cross-browser check.

tools.name: retrieveScreenshots
tools.description: Get the results of a takeScreenshot job: each browser's status and links to its screenshot and thumbnail.

tools.name: getScreenshotList
tools.description: List the account's earlier screenshot jobs (from takeScreenshot), newest first, with each job's ID, state and creation time.

tools.name: getUserInfo
tools.description: Show your own TestingBot account: name, email, company, plan, testing time left (seconds available) and concurrency limits for VMs and mobile devices.

tools.name: updateUserInfo
tools.description: Change your own TestingBot account's first name, last name or email.

tools.name: startLiveSession
tools.description: Create a link that opens a live (manual, interactive) testing session in the user's TestingBot dashboard, for a person to test by hand.

tools.name: getTeam
tools.description: Retrieve team settings: plan details, team size, and concurrency (parallel sessions allowed, running now, and queued waiting for a free slot, for VMs and physical devices).

tools.name: getUsersInTeam
tools.description: List the members of the account's TestingBot team with each user's ID, email, plan, roles, read-only flag and concurrency limit.

tools.name: getUserFromTeam
tools.description: Show one team member's details: name, email, role, whether the account is active, join date and last login.

tools.name: createCdpSession
tools.description: Start a remote browser on TestingBot and return its Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket URL, for connecting your own Puppeteer or Playwright script to it.

tools.name: getTunnelList
tools.description: List the account's running TestingBot tunnels with their ID, identifier, status and IP, and mark the ones this server started.

tools.name: deleteTunnel
tools.description: Shut down a running tunnel on TestingBot's side by its numeric ID, ending every session that goes through it.

tools.name: startTunnel
tools.description: Start a TestingBot Tunnel on this machine so remote browsers and devices can reach localhost, private-network and intranet URLs.

tools.name: stopTunnel
tools.description: Stop a TestingBot Tunnel that was started with startTunnel.

tools.name: getFailureLogs
tools.description: Download a test's log files (selenium, browser console, chrome, vm, appium) and return their text, one section per log.

tools.name: getVisualTests
tools.description: List the account's hosted visual regression tests with each test's ID, name, URL, browsers and whether it is paused.

tools.name: getVisualRuns
tools.description: List visual runs (one browser's screenshot compared with its baseline), newest first, with each run's ID, name, browser, verdict, percentage of pixels changed versus its threshold, date and run page link.

tools.name: explainVisualRun
tools.description: Explain what changed in one visual run: each changed region and what it is, an AI description of the change when the account has AI region names on, text and CSS changes from the page, and links to the screenshot, bas...

tools.name: reviewVisualRun
tools.description: Approve or reject a visual run, the same as on its run page in the dashboard.

tools.name: getAccessibilityTests
tools.description: List the account's scheduled accessibility tests (each scans one URL on a schedule), with each test's name, ID, URL, whether it is paused, and its latest run.

tools.name: getAccessibilityRuns
tools.description: List the scans (runs) of one accessibility test, newest first, with each run's ID, score and issue counts.

tools.name: getAccessibilityFindings
tools.description: Show what an accessibility scan found: failing WCAG A/AA rules with the failing elements (CSS selector, HTML snippet, how to fix), checks that need human review, best-practice recommendations, and which issues are new...

tools.name: runAccessibilityTest
tools.description: Start a scan of a scheduled accessibility test right now, the same as Run now in the dashboard, instead of waiting for its schedule.

tools.name: getAiFailureAnalysis
tools.description: Read the AI failure analysis (TestingBot AI Insights) of a test: summary, root cause, timeline, log evidence, suggested fixes, failure category, likely owner and confidence.

tools.name: analyzeTestFailure
tools.description: Explain why a test failed with TestingBot AI Insights.

tools.name: listTestFiles
tools.description: Find the test files in a local project: detects the framework (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Selenium (JS), Nightwatch, Puppeteer, Jest, Mocha, Vitest, Maestro, Espresso or XCUITest) and returns the relative paths...

tools.name: setupTestingBot
tools.description: Detect the testing framework in a project and return the ready-to-paste TestingBot configuration snippet, install command, and env-var requirements.

tools.name: maestroCheatSheet
tools.description: Get a Maestro flow YAML syntax reference: file structure, commands, selectors, and the TestingBot run workflow.

tools.name: uploadMaestroApp
tools.description: Upload a mobile app (APK, AAB, IPA, or zipped .app) for Maestro testing on TestingBot.

tools.name: uploadMaestroFlows
tools.description: Upload Maestro flow YAML files for a project.

tools.name: runMaestroTest
tools.description: Start a Maestro test run on a TestingBot device.

tools.name: getMaestroRunStatus
tools.description: Check whether a Maestro run has finished: returns each run's status (WAITING, READY = running, DONE, FAILED, CANCELLED), device and flow results so far.

tools.name: getMaestroRunResults
tools.description: Get the final results of a finished Maestro run: each flow's outcome (failures first, with error messages and video links) plus the JUnit XML report.

tools.name: uploadMaestroCompanionApp
tools.description: Upload a companion app (.apk/.aab/.ipa) that should be installed alongside the app under test in a Maestro run.

tools.name: listMaestroProjects
tools.description: List the account's Maestro projects, newest first, with the app details, flow names and run IDs of each.

tools.name: listMaestroRuns
tools.description: List Maestro runs across all projects (newest first), or look up runs by their build/run name.

tools.name: getMaestroFlowDetails
tools.description: Get the detailed result of a single Maestro flow: error messages, step-level JUnit report, and links to the video, screenshots, and device logs.

tools.name: cancelMaestroRun
tools.description: Stop a Maestro run that is still waiting or running, releasing its devices.

tools.name: retryMaestroRun
tools.description: Run a finished Maestro run again on the same app and flows, or only one failed flow when `flowId` is given (get it from getMaestroRunStatus).

tools.name: uploadAppAutomateApp
tools.description: Upload the app under test for an Espresso (.apk/.aab) or XCUITest (.ipa) run on TestingBot.

tools.name: uploadAppAutomateTests
tools.description: Upload the test suite for an Espresso or XCUITest project: the instrumented test APK for Espresso, or the zipped XCUITest runner bundle (.zip) for XCUITest.

tools.name: runAppAutomateTest
tools.description: Start an Espresso or XCUITest run on a TestingBot device.

tools.name: getAppAutomateRunStatus
tools.description: Check whether an Espresso or XCUITest run has finished: returns each run's status (WAITING, READY = running, DONE, FAILED) and device.

tools.name: getAppAutomateRunResults
tools.description: Get the results of a finished Espresso or XCUITest project: each run's outcome plus the JUnit XML report with per-test results.

tools.name: tb_openBrowser
tools.description: Start a remote browser session on TestingBot via WebDriver.

tools.name: tb_navigate
tools.description: Load a URL in an open browser session (from tb_openBrowser).

tools.name: tb_snapshot
tools.description: Describe the current page of a browser session: title, URL, headings, the text of links and buttons, and the start of the body text (`bodyChars`, default 5000).

tools.name: tb_click
tools.description: Click one element in a browser session.

tools.name: tb_type
tools.description: Type text into an input, textarea or other editable element in a browser session.

tools.name: tb_getText
tools.description: Return the visible text of one element in a browser session, for example to check a heading, status message or price.

tools.name: tb_getAttribute
tools.description: Return one attribute of an element in a browser session, e.g.

tools.name: tb_executeScript
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the current page of a browser session and return its result as JSON.

tools.name: tb_closeBrowser
tools.description: End a browser session opened with tb_openBrowser and stop billing TestingBot minutes for it.

tools.name: tb_screenshot
tools.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the current page in a browser session.

tools.name: tb_pressKey
tools.description: Press a key or key combination in a browser session, sent to the element that currently has focus (not to a selector).

tools.name: tb_listSessions
tools.description: List the browser sessions this server has open, with their IDs, capabilities, age, idle time and live-view links.

tools.name: appium_session_management
tools.description: Manage TestingBot mobile-device sessions.

tools.name: appium_mobile_device_control
tools.description: Control device behavior: lock/unlock the screen, shake the device, or open the notifications panel.

tools.name: appium_geolocation
tools.description: Get, set, or reset the device geolocation (GPS coordinates).

tools.name: appium_mobile_device_info
tools.description: Get device information, battery status, or current device time in a single call.

tools.name: appium_mobile_file
tools.description: Push or pull a file using Appium mobile extensions.

tools.name: appium_driver_settings
tools.description: Read or update Appium driver session settings (e.g.

tools.name: appium_gesture
tools.description: Perform a touch gesture.

tools.name: appium_drag_and_drop
tools.description: Perform a drag-and-drop gesture from a source location to a target location.

tools.name: appium_perform_actions
tools.description: Execute raw W3C Actions API sequences for advanced multi-touch gestures not covered by appium_gesture.

tools.name: appium_find_element
tools.description: Find an element by strategy and selector.

tools.name: appium_find_elements
tools.description: Find all elements matching a strategy and selector.

tools.name: appium_mobile_press_key
tools.description: Press navigation keys (BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH) on Android or physical buttons (HOME, volume, etc.) on iOS/tvOS.

tools.name: appium_set_value
tools.description: Enter text into an element

tools.name: appium_mobile_keyboard
tools.description: Hide the software keyboard or check if it is visible (Android UiAutomator2 / iOS XCUITest).

tools.name: appium_get_text
tools.description: Get text from an element

tools.name: appium_get_element_attribute
tools.description: Get the value of an element attribute.

tools.name: appium_mobile_clipboard
tools.description: Read or set the device clipboard as plain text (Android UiAutomator2 / iOS XCUITest).

tools.name: appium_get_active_element
tools.description: Get the currently active/focused element and return its UUID for follow-up interactions.

tools.name: appium_get_page_source
tools.description: Get current-screen XML.

tools.name: appium_orientation
tools.description: Get or set the device/screen orientation.

tools.name: appium_alert
tools.description: Handle system alerts with action=accept|dismiss, or read alert text with action=get_text.

tools.name: appium_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot and save as PNG.

tools.name: appium_get_window_size
tools.description: Get the width and height of the device screen in pixels.

tools.name: appium_screen_recording
tools.description: Start or stop screen recording.

tools.name: appium_app_lifecycle
tools.description: Manage app lifecycle, installation, state, data, and deep links.

tools.name: appium_mobile_permissions
tools.description: Get/update Android app permissions or iOS Simulator privacy services; reset iOS privacy prompts.

tools.name: appium_context
tools.description: Manage Appium contexts with one tool.

tools.name: generate_locators
tools.description: Generate current-page locator candidates for inspection.

tools.name: appium_generate_tests
tools.description: Return a workflow to execute the scenario with MCP tools, then generate test code from observed interactions.

testingbot-key.title: TestingBot API key
testingbot-key.description: Your TestingBot API key, from https://testingbot.com/members/user/security. Leave empty to sign in from Claude with tb_login instead.

testingbot-secret.title: TestingBot API secret
testingbot-secret.description: Your TestingBot API secret, from https://testingbot.com/members/user/security. Leave empty to sign in from Claude with tb_login instead.
